en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a bustling outdoor market scene in front of historic multi‑story buildings. Numerous vendors and shoppers, many in early 20th‑century dress, stand among stalls, carts, and large baskets filled with produce under canvas umbrellas. The architecture features Italianate facades with arched windows, balconies, and awnings. A printed caption appears in the lower margin.
